title: Admission Counselor
description:
Designation: Course Advisor/Course Counselor/**Sr Admision Counselor**,

Location:TransGlobe Academy - **Kaloor**, Kathrikkadavu

Key Responsibilities:

* Provide Pre-sales counselling to students regarding admissions by any of the customers preferred means -in-center, online, etc.
* Responsible for complete sales funnel management & ensuring updation of enquiries, solving the student queries, follow-up with students, and enrollments/ handling registrations.
* Ensure benefits and advantages of enrollment are shared with students to encourage conversions.
* Ensure the high rate of conversion of all leads- telephonic, forwarded, and referrals to be successful in achieving the performance goals.
* Gather & collate accurate client information on prescribed enquirer forms from walk-ins and a timely update on the portal.
* Monitoring and follow up of creation of schedules.
* Be responsibly proactive in up-selling and cross-selling relevant products.
* Ensure efficient & appropriate communication with students.
* Be proactive for self-development initiatives.

Admission Counselor,Course Advisor,Admission Consultant,,BDE, Business Development Officer, Tele-caller

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
